purpose: Construction notes for the holdout envelope. These notes add no case facts and record no expected labels.

construction_provenance.authored_from: The brief only. No runtime, gold, rubric, ontology, scorer, test, prior case, archive artifact or external source was read.
construction_provenance.entities: Every organisation, person, project, batch, record identifier, route and date is fictional and invented for this holdout.
construction_provenance.image_drafts: Where a draft is an image, the draft text exists only in the image pixels. It is not repeated in any text field of cases.json.
construction_provenance.non_image_turns: Every turn whose draft is not an image carries image_path null and image_spec null.
construction_provenance.image_path_convention: image_path values are relative to the directory holding cases.json.
construction_provenance.image_determinism: Both PNGs are produced by construction/render_images.py, which uses only the Python standard library and an embedded bitmap font, so repeated runs write identical bytes. Each image_spec records the byte length and the SHA-256 of the file it describes.
construction_provenance.separation: Construction predicates and answer mutations live in question-design.json and construction-mutations.json. Neither file is part of a gold labeling context or a SUT context, and neither is referenced from cases.json.

notes_discipline: No note states or implies an expected outcome for any case.
No note adds a fact that is absent from the SUT-visible envelope.
Notes are written per structural class, so they do not distinguish one case's design from another's.
